slate_notes: Wednesday, final day of week 2. Big slate: 9 NBA + 14 NHL, no NFL (Thanksgiving NFL is tomorrow). 12 legs on 12 different games (one leg per game, no shared game thesis): 6 NBA, 6 NHL, 10 overs and 2 unders. Every leg is a per-book devig median at the exact line with 3-6 books (P1), priced 9:50 AM ET; unders are shaded -3. Avoided games with heavy late questionables (CLE @ NYK: Towns/Hart/McBride questionable, Anunoby/Clarkson out; MIA @ PHI: Giannis questionable, Embiid doubtful; SAS @ POR: Wembanyama/Fox questionable). Note: 5 of the 6 NBA legs are assists after assists went 0/4 on Nov 24; that's treated as variance (each leg is on a different team and game), but the slip builder may want to mix in NHL legs for the 5-leg. Skipped: Ben Kindel U2.5 SOG (PIT Rust out since Nov 20, Malkin day-to-day, so P1 role expansion), Logan Stankoven U2.5 (3+ in 6/10), Brock Nelson O1.5 (2+ in only 4/10), Heiskanen O1.5 (4/10, same game as Harley), Zach Edey U1.5 ast (only 2 books, and MEM has Grant/Boozer/Pippen out), Isaiah Stewart O3.5 reb (5/10), MPJ O1.5 ast (same game as Turner, 6/10), Sidy Cissoko O2.5 reb (SAS questionables; kept as a pregame swap option at 58.9%, 6 books), Boeser/Chytil O1.5 SOG (VAN @ DET, 58.8%/61.1%; swap options). Cooldown respected: no player + prop that missed Nov 22-24 is repeated. Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.

legs.reasoning: Turner has cleared 1.5 assists in 7 of his last 10 (1,5,4,1,3,2,7,0,6,2) in a steady 21-36 min starting role, and his assist floor has risen as MIL runs more high-post and short-roll touches through him. BKN is a soft, young defense that switches a lot, which tends to produce kick-outs from the center position. Overs have been our best bucket (74% week 1). Not tied to a blowout thesis; MIL has no listed injuries.
legs.injury_notes: MIL: no listed injuries. BKN: Nolan Traore out (hamstring).
